edition_intro: The window on these opportunities is open right now, not someday. From a $10,000 energy innovation grant to a scholarship route into Germany's top graduate schools, every listing below is live, verifiable, and free to apply to. Move on the ones that fit your work before the deadlines below close.

posts.title: Heinrich Boll Foundation International Scholarship 2026/2027
posts.summary: Fully funded Master's and PhD study in Germany for outstanding students from developing countries, including a monthly stipend and book allowance.
posts.eligibility: International students admitted to or applying for a Master's or PhD programme in Germany, priority to first-time applicants from DAC-list countries including Nigeria

posts.title: AEIP Scholars Programme 2026/2027
posts.summary: A fully sponsored Africa-Europe research collaboration pairing ten young scholars to co-develop solutions and present at international dialogues.
posts.eligibility: Researchers aged 25-35 enrolled in PhD, postdoc, or advanced study, based in Africa or Europe and affiliated with a recognised institution

posts.title: Gates Cambridge Scholarship 2027
posts.summary: Full-ride funding to pursue any postgraduate course at the University of Cambridge, covering tuition, living costs, and travel.
posts.eligibility: Nigerian citizens applying for a Master's or PhD at Cambridge for 2027/28 entry; must apply through the Cambridge course application and opt in for Gates funding

posts.title: Social Shifters Global Innovation Challenge 2026
posts.summary: Up to $15,000 in grant funding for young founders already running a social-impact venture, with no equity taken.
posts.eligibility: Founders aged 18-30 with decision-making authority over a startup or project already delivering measurable social or environmental impact

posts.title: USAID Development Innovation Ventures (DIV) Fund
posts.summary: Rolling grants from $25,000 up to $5 million for evidence-backed, cost-effective innovations tackling development challenges in USAID-supported countries.
posts.eligibility: Individuals, nonprofits, and for-profit organisations with a project operating in a USAID-supported country, including Nigeria

posts.title: One Young World Leading Scholarship 2026
posts.summary: Fully funded delegate place at the One Young World Summit 2026 in Cape Town, covering flights, hotel, and meals for four days.
posts.eligibility: Young leaders aged 18-35 with a demonstrated record of impact, priority given to first-time Summit attendees from under-represented countries

posts.title: ECOWAS Startup Awards 2026
posts.summary: A regional pitch competition offering $65,000 in cash prizes to the top three West African startups, with no equity taken.
posts.eligibility: Startups based in an ECOWAS member state, founded or led by citizens of ECOWAS countries, operating in EdTech, FinTech, HealthTech, AgriTech, CleanTech, or Tourism

posts.title: Africa Energy Innovation Challenge (AEIC) 2026
posts.summary: A pan-African pitch competition offering up to $10,000 in grant prizes plus mentorship for youth-led energy and sustainability solutions.
posts.eligibility: Teams of at least three people aged 18-35, including at least one woman and one man, proposing solutions to energy access, agribusiness, fintech, AI, or connectivity challenges

posts.title: 3MTT DeepTech_Ready Upskilling Programme
posts.summary: A free, government-backed six-month training track in AI, data science, and deep tech, with certification and internship pathways.
posts.eligibility: Nigerian citizens, including 3MTT Fellows and individuals with basic to intermediate technical knowledge

posts.title: IBM SkillsBuild Free Courses and Certificates
posts.summary: Unlimited free access to IBM's course catalogue in AI, cybersecurity, data, and cloud, with digital certificates on completion.
posts.eligibility: Open to all learners globally, including students, recent graduates, and career changers in Nigeria

posts.title: TechUp Africa TAMP DataCamp Tech Skills Scholarship 2026
posts.summary: Free premium access to over 450 DataCamp courses in data science, AI, Python, and SQL for young Africans, delivered through DataCamp Donates.
posts.eligibility: Young Africans, students, recent graduates, and career changers able to commit to active learning for three to six months

posts.title: Google Career Certificates via Coursera Financial Aid
posts.summary: Fully sponsored access to Google's job-ready certificates in IT Support, Data Analytics, Cybersecurity, UX Design, and Project Management.
posts.eligibility: Any learner globally who demonstrates financial need, including Nigerian applicants
